Crossing Texas has been a challenge with torrential rains, high velocity winds, cold, and some below freezing nights.

Of course Texas is big, and the East side of Texas is very different from the West, with each posing a different set of challenges.

In some parts, especially near large cities, much of the rural land is fenced, gated and locked, primary reason to keep the illegal hunters out.

There are many hunters and much gun fire can be heard, but generally the people are quite friendly and considerate.
Old abandoned cotton gin facility was a lifesaver. Torrential rains and high velocity winds along with freezing cold.
4 pm ... Cold as winter in West Texas.

Past three days have been cold, wet and windy. The challenge of the struggle is good for the soul.

It was so cold, I stopped to price an economy hotel in a small town (Brownfield, Texas).

Own by an Indian couple, she said the room was normally 60 USD but would give it to me for 30 USD.

Still I did not feel a room for a night to be worth so much, so camped in an abandoned warehouse anyway.

I was comfortable dry and warm, and have no regrets.

Man's most basic needs are said to be food, clothing, and shelter. Beyond these are community and education.

Poverty in the information age is rooted in either misplaced ambition or lack of ambition, and education.

Without ambition, education is not possible, and it is through education, whether it be self-education or institutional education, that we acquire our personal skill-sets that bring us wealth and fulfillment.

Much of the GPS data for Europe 2018 was lost due to an Android malfunction.

Bus transport was used between Firenze, Italy and Prague.

Ferries were used between Albania and Italy, as well as between France and the UK.

Two year around the world trip, accomplished on less than five US dollars per day, all expenses included.

World travel this cheap can only be done alone, with a bicycle, camping most all the time, and preparing your own food.

Extreme sport - obviously not for everyone.
